in_hindi.name: देवभय
in_hindi.meaning: देव (देवा, देवता) + भय (भयानक, घोब़ा, रोढ़ा, रोग)
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who fears God or is afraid of God or Goddess

in_telugu.name: దేవభేయ
in_telugu.meaning: దేవ (God) + భేయ (బేజ, పొభే, పొయ్యెజ్జే, శోక, శోక)
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who fears God or is afraid of God or Goddess

in_marathi.name: Devabhay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devabhay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit, ‘Deva’ meaning god and ‘bhay’ meaning fearless. This name is believed to be bestowed upon a child who is brave and fearless, instilling confidence in the face of adversity.
